description: Advisory checks for documented Gamesight impression options on gsght.com/imgp/{tracker}. Explicit indexed External IDs carrying only literal org scope values are expected to supply an opaque organization ID in that same row. Unindexed pairing, ID grammar, custom domains, account state and receiver acceptance remain outside this partial profile.

params.name: tracker_id
params.description: Retain the opaque tracker slot from the published impression template.

params.name: cost_model
params.description: Published cost options; no server rejection claim.

params.name: external_hash_mode
params.description: Documented hashing modes, with unset values left open.

params.name: attribution_window
params.description: This option applies to click links.

params.name: destination_url
params.description: Redirect overrides apply to click links.

params.name: scope_type
params.description: Row-local discriminator only. Existing URL-family checks retain the published scope options. Mixed, blank and macro discriminator observations do not activate the org dependency.

params.name: scope_id
params.description: The linked common External IDs guide asks for scope_type=org and the Organization ID as scope_id for cross-game sharing. This is a local advisory for explicit numeric indexed URL rows, with no identifier grammar or receiver rejection claim.
params.fix_hint: Supply the organization ID in scope_id for this same indexed External ID.
